steps.journalDescription: Nándor and Guard Márcos have explained that the best way to seal the breach is to convince the guards stuck on the mine's third level to collapse it with blasting jelly. If they are uncooperative, then we will instead need to kill them and take their blasting jelly for ourselves. I can find the guards in a tunnel to the southeast of Nándor's camp.

I have convinced Overseer Gáspár and his guards to help close the tunnel that the worms are coming through. I should proceed to the deepest part of the mine to the south and with their help, finish this.

I have slain Overseer Gáspár and his guards, and taken their blasting jelly. Now I should return to Guard Márcos in the northwest part of the third level of the mine and have him prepare the jelly for use.
Guard Márcos has explained how to prepare and use the blasting jelly. I should proceed to the deepest part of the mine to the south and finish this.
Guard Márcos is the only one with the will and knowledge to close the pocket that the worms came from. I should proceed to the deepest part of the mine to the south and finish this.

I fought my way to the tunnel the worms were coming from and, with the guards help, closed the tunnel for good. Afterwards, I sided with the guards after the other slaves attempted to escape their custody.
I fought my way to the tunnel the worms were coming from and, using my wits and a little blasting jelly, closed the tunnel for good.
I fought my way to the tunnel the worms were coming from. Once there, Guard Márcos used the blasting jelly to close the tunnel for good, but died in the process.

I fought my way to the tunnel the worms were coming from and, with the guards help, closed the tunnel for good. Afterwards, I attempted to force the guards to surrender to me without a fight, but only two of them took my offer. I was forced to kill the rest.
I fought my way to the tunnel the worms were coming from and, with the guards help, closed the tunnel for good. Afterwards, I slew the guards when they attempted to apprehend me.

I brought Nándor and the other survivors back to the surface without sealing the breach as they had asked. While we were preparing our revolution, the worms spilled from the cave and attacked the camp. We will now have to fight them and the guards at the same time.
